walls.heading: Background
walls.text:
An assassin hiding in a small chapel within the Catacombs, concealed behind an illusory wall. As well as dropping the Assassin's Cerulean Dagger, which allows the player to recover FP from critical hits, she also leaves behind a Black Knifeprint, which can be given to Sorcerer Rogier to progress his questline.

D, Hunter of the Dead can be summoned for this fight.

walls.heading: Overview
walls.text:
Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and are known to be unshakable trackers. Without language, they choose their own master whom they will stay loyal to for the rest of their life.

walls.text: The Cathedral of the Forsaken is a catacombs prayer room in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds deep below Leyndell, Royal Capital. This area is the boss room for Mohg, the Omen. Rows of simple pews line the room, facing an altar flanked by statues of skeletal shepherds carrying a ghostflame censer. walls.text:
The Church of the Cuckoo is a small prayer room with pews and birdcages at the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The Knights of the Cuckoo and scholars venerated the Cuckoo within this nave.

walls.text:

walls.text:
Warp to the Altus Plateau and explore the western area until you find the Lux Ruins. Nearby will be a Golden Seed and the "Erdtree-Gazing Hill" grace. Talk to Millicent at the grace and then with Rya in the Lux Ruins, if you haven't already spoken to Rya after taking the Grand Lift of Dectus way back in Step 11.

walls.text:
Margit's Shackle can be reused repeatedly.

It can be used against both Margit the Fell Omen and Morgott, the Omen King during phase 1 of their fight to stun them for about 5 seconds.

walls.heading: *Player Phantoms*
walls.text:
Spectral afterimages of other players exploring and interacting with the world in their own game. The moments captured are mere recent short recordings of their journey and are not quite real-time.

Outside of being a reminder than in some way one is never truly alone in the adventure, these momentary glimpses into the lives of other players may directly assist the person witnessing them in reveal

walls.text: Found in a chest atop Rabbath's Rise northeast of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr in eastern Scadu Altus. To reach it, unseal the Spiritspring by breaking the sealing stones hidden behind the illusory wall on the rise's lower balcony.

walls.heading: Overview
walls.text: A secluded series of catacombs built into the cliffs of western Liurnia, south-west of the Minor Erdtree (West Liurnia). Illusory walls obscure the route through this dungeon, which is guarded by imps.

walls.text:

  - Rya can be found in a folly north of the Laskyar Ruins. Speak to her and exhaust her dialogue, then travel to Boilprawn Shack and purchase Rya's Necklace from Blackguard Big Boggart. Return to Rya and hand over the necklace to rec

walls.heading: Overview
walls.text:
A mining tunnel in the south-eastern Capital Outskirts. An illusory wall in the cave containing the Site of Grace conceals the entrance to the dungeon proper, and a second illusory wall in the next cave hides a lift which leads to the rest of the dungeon.

The tunnel eventually leads to a fight against an Onyx Lord, beyond which is an opening which allows access to the Divine Tower of West Altus.

walls.heading: Effects
walls.text:
- Used to transplant Sorceress Sellen's soul into a new body, advancing her questline.
- Take it to the puppet of a Glintstone Sorceress behind the illusory wall in Seluvis's Rise at Three Sisters to initiate the transplant.
- Completing this step allows access to the final choice in Sellen's questline at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library.

walls.heading: Overview
walls.text: A crystal cave north-east of Sellia, Town of Sorcery and the Church of the Plague, hidden behind an illusory wall in the cliffs behind the cemetery. As well as the miners who can be found harvesting the crystals, the cave is also home to a number of sorcerers. One of the founding sorcerers of the Academy of Raya Lucaria has hidden away here, protected by a seal that can only be broken by a Sellian

walls.heading: Sellia Hideaway
walls.text: Found at the start of the dungeon, past the illusory wall.

walls.heading: Notes
walls.text:
- The seal is located behind an illusory wall in Sellia Hideaway.
- This blue key is shaped like a dagger and depicts a Chair-Crypt surrounded by shooting stars.

walls.heading: Acquisition
walls.text: - Obtained from a chest in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, Forbidden Lands. From the large circular platform in the large central room, drop straight down from the broken railing to land on an invisible platform, and walk directly South to a small room. Dispel the illusory wall behind a Grave Glovewort (9) to reveal the chest.

walls.text:
